description: CONTROL for wc-classify: the IDENTICAL graph shape over a LONGER document, which must land on a DIFFERENT label (LONG -> report_long) than its pairing (SHORT -> report_short). A single flow proves nothing -- a graph stuck on one branch would pass it too. Same limit as its pairing: the word count in the prompt is a hand-copied literal, because the engine has no interpolation (crates/laya-graph/src/lower.rs:104).

nodes.prompt: A shell command counted the words in a document. It printed: {{count_words}}
nodes.question: By the rule stated, is this document SHORT, MEDIUM or LONG?
